canonical_name: Lucas-Lehmer primality criterion for Mersenne numbers
canonical_statement: For every natural exponent p with 3 <= p, the Lucas-Lehmer residue after p - 2 zero-based updates from seed 4 is zero modulo 2^p - 1 if and only if the Mersenne number 2^p - 1 is prime.
domain_and_universes: p : Nat in Lean universe 0; LucasLehmer.lucasLehmerResidue p : ZMod (2^p - 1); mersenne p : Nat; the closed target is Prop in universe 0.
conclusion: LucasLehmer.LucasLehmerTest p if and only if Nat.Prime (mersenne p). The test definition is LucasLehmer.lucasLehmerResidue p = 0, with residue sZMod p (p - 2).
minimal_import_evidence: The sole direct import is the exact-topic public module defining mersenne, the recurrence, residue, and test. Removing it makes the statement module fail. No aggregate Mathlib import or additional direct module is present. Because the vocabulary itself is owned by this module, a smaller direct-import set cannot state the selected target.
